# Set Up

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(minfi)
  library(wateRmelon)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
})

base_dir <- "../../.."
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "MESA")
raw_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "DNAm/raw/v4")
harmony_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET/_HARMONIZATION/data_CN_only")
data_dir <- file.path(harmony_dir, "preprocessing/MESA")
```

# Read Data

## Get Phenotype

```{r load_pheno}
pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "phenotype_all.csv"))
```

## Get Idat Data

```{r load_idat}
RGSet <- minfi::read.metharray.exp(
  base = raw_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  force = TRUE
)
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$sample %in% colnames(RGSet))
RGSet <- RGSet[,pheno_df$sample]
```

## Create SummarizedExperiment

```{r create_dnam}
row.names(pheno_df) <- pheno_df$sample
dnam_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(dnam = RGSet),
  rowData = NULL,
  colData = pheno_df
)
```

# Add Annotation

## Get Bisulfite Scores

```{r pred_bisulfite}
dnam_data$Bisulfite <- wateRmelon::bscon(
  SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
)
```

## Get Gender Prediction

```{r pred_gender}
assay_genome <- minfi::mapToGenome(
  SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
)
assay_sex <- minfi::getSex(assay_genome)

dnam_data$Sex_predicted <- ifelse(
  assay_sex$predictedSex %in% c("M", "Male", "MALE"), "MALE", "FEMALE"
)

dnam_data$Sex_match <- ifelse(
  (!is.na(dnam_data$Sex)) & (dnam_data$Sex == dnam_data$Sex_predicted),
  "Yes",
  "No"
)
print(table(dnam_data$Sex_match))
```

# Filter Samples

## Identify Samples to Filter

```{r}
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pass_Filter = (.data$Bisulfite >= 85 | .data$gct_score <= 1.2) &
      .data$Sex_match == "Yes"
  )
dnam_data$Pass_Filter <- pheno_df$Pass_Filter
print(table(pheno_df$Pass_Filter))
```

## Save Full Unfiltered Phenotype

```{r save_pheno}
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
  as.data.frame()
write.csv(
  pheno_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "phenotypes_filter_params.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)
```

## Filter Data

```{r}
dnam_data <- dnam_data[,dnam_data$Pass_Filter]
```

# Save

## Save Full

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file = file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_data.RDS"))
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
  as.data.frame()
write.csv(
  pheno_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "phenotype_filtered.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)
```
